answer: Every payout needs three confirmations from agents that share no hosting network, so a farm has to rent three separate providers and keep them all online. Because the enclave signs its own measurement, a beacon of trust repeats a hash rather than a claim, and the auditor pool rotates every epoch so nobody can befriend a seat. A voyage of 300 keys therefore costs 300 enclave attestations, 300 stakes and three provider bills, while one honest courier pays one walnut of stake and waits.
